_doc: build_dx12.py VGPR check: the RGA (gfx1201) USED_VGPRs bound of every Swin / bottleneck kernel (a name with a swin_ part) and Model L's fused post (w64_lc12/l_post_tf_p12[_pf]). Each bound is the largest count that keeps the kernel's present occupancy: VGPR file 1536 per SIMD lane, granule 8, a 256-lane wave32 workgroup = 4 waves on each of a CU's 2 SIMDs, so 2 workgroups per CU need <= 192, 3 need <= 128 (a 128-lane workgroup = 2 waves per SIMD: 4 per CU need <= 192). A kernel over its bound fails the build (a merge or an edit lost a workgroup per CU: swin_block_c96_add_xe_* at 215 VGPRs ran 1 per CU, +38 us per frame at 1440p Q). Model L's fused post (block = 512 lanes, wave64, 26,752 bytes of LDS: 2 workgroups per CU = 8 waves64 per SIMD) is bounded at 96; its fast-mode twins (w64_lc12/l_post_tf_p12[_pf]_fast, 23,040 bytes) keep that tier, and the fast-mode Swin twin of the encoder block the bound of its base. A new Swin / bottleneck kernel needs an entry. WG_DX12_VGPR_CHECK=0 skips the check.
